judge.voice: Priya sounds properly Dublin, and "just your appetite?" made me smile. But it was over in three replies and I was never stretched. Once I'd declined, it was just Wednesday, half twelve, which café. No banter to read, no push-back, nothing I didn't already know. The recap gave me "I can't tonight, next time for sure?", which is what I'd say to a stranger, and my own line was better. It also said I used help once, and I never touched Help. That makes me doubt its other numbers. No corrections came, which is fair because I made no slips, but I got no new idiom or register choice either. For 15 minutes whenever, I'd try the disagreeing-with-a-senior scene. This one wouldn't replace Preply for me yet.
